|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The Table class provides a flattened view of grouped and hierarchical records and
manages all the records from the underlying source list.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public class Table : Element, IContainerElement,  	IElementTreeTableSource, IElement, IDisposable ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Class Table _ 	Inherits Element _ 	Implements IContainerElement, IElementTreeTableSource, IElement, IDisposable ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public ref class Table : public Element,  	IContainerElement, IElementTreeTableSource, IElement, IDisposable ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public class Table extends Element implements IContainerElement, IElementTreeTableSource, IElement, IDisposable ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Grouping.Table = function();  Type.createClass( 	'Syncfusion.Grouping.Table', 	Syncfusion.Grouping.Element, 	Syncfusion.Grouping.Internals.IContainerElement, 	Syncfusion.Grouping.Internals.IElementTreeTableSource, 	Syncfusion.Grouping.Internals.IElement, 	IDisposable); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The table manages all the records from the underlying source list. The source list can be any
IList collection. If it implements IBindingList, the table will listen to the ListChangedEvent
and update its internal data whenever changes are made to the source list.When the Table is initialized for the first time it will loop through all items in the source
list and create a record object. The record object will be initialized with an index to the underlying
source list item so that it can locate the item when you call its Record.GetData() property.
Record.GetData() looks up the item in the underlying source list and returns a reference to it.Once a record object has been initialized, it will stay attached to the underlying item. When
records are inserted or moved, this relation will stay intact. The only time this link between
record and the underlying item is released is when the underlying item gets deleted from the
source list. In that event, the record object gets disposed. A record's sorted record index
within the table can at any time be determined with the Table.Records.IndexOf(record) method.
This method will always return the accurate index respecting any insertions, movements, or changes
that were made in the source list.When looping through the source list and intializing the records, the table also checks
if categorization of data is necessary. When the TableDescriptor.RelationChildColumns or
TableDescriptor.GroupedColumns collection are not empty, groups will be created for
each new category.A table has one main group, the TopLevelGroup. The TopLevelGroup
gives you access to a list of child groups and child records.The order of records and groups is defined by the TableDescriptor with schema
information about the table. Once you make changes to the TableDescriptor, the
table will be updated on demand the first time you try to access elements of the table after
the change.There are multiple ways to get access to a specific record:

* **The UnsortedRecords collection of the Table class provides access to the records
  in the same order as they appear in the datasource. The IndexOf(Record) method
  of a UnsortedRecordsCollection determines the index of any record in the underlying datasource.** -
* **The Records collection of the Table class provides access to the records
  in the order as they were sorted in the engine. The IndexOf(Record) method
  of a RecordsInTableCollection determines the index of any record in the Table.Records collection.** -
* **The FilteredRecords collection of the Table class provides access to records that
  meet filter criteria in the order they were sorted in the engine. The IndexOf(Record) method
  of a RecordsInTableCollection determines the index of any record in the Table.FilteredRecords collection.** -
* **The Records collection of the Group class provides access to the records
  in the order they appear in the group. The IndexOf(String) method
  of a RecordsInDetailsCollection determines the index of any record in the Group.Records collection.** -
* **The FilteredRecords collection of the Group class provides access to the records
  in the order they appear in the group. The IndexOf(Record) method
  of a FilteredRecordsInDetailsCollection determines the index of any record in the Group.FilteredRecords collection.** -

Any element in the table can be accessed using its element or display index. There are four
collections that let you access elements:

* **The DisplayElements collection of the Table class provides access to the visible
  display elements. The IndexOf(Element) method
  of a DisplayElementsInTableCollection determines the visible index of any element in the table.With a GridGroupingControl, the index of display elements is the same as the row index in the grid. Therefore,
  given a row index of the grid you can easily determine the element that is to be shown at the specific row. Vice versa,
  if you do have an element, you can easily determine its row index with the IndexOf(Element) method.
  The DisplayElements collection does not step into a NestedTable element.** -
* **The NestedDisplayElements collection of the Table class provides access to the visible
  display elements and nested elements inside nested tables. The IndexOf(Element) method
  of a DisplayElementsInTableCollection determines the visible index of any element in the table.The NestedDisplayElements collection steps into a NestedTable element.** -
* **The Elements collection returns all elements of the Table
  in the order as they appear if they would be visible. Any element is returned, also records that are not visible
  in the DisplayElements collection because a parent group was collapsed are returned.
  The IndexOf(Element) method
  of a ElementsInTableCollection determines the index of any element in the Table.Elements collection.** -
* **The NestedElements collection returns all elements of the Table
  in the order as they appear if they would be visible and also steps into nested tables.
  The IndexOf(Element) method
  of a ElementsInTableCollection determines the index of any element in the Table.NestedElements collection.** -

A table has a CurrentRecord or CurrentElement which identifies the current record. The current
record can be edited and navigated with the CurrentRecordManager.A table raises various events when changes are made to a record or when groups or records are collapsed or expanded. All
events will bubble up to the parent engine object.If an engine displays hierarchical data, a Table is created for each table of the
datasource. With a DataSet for example, a Table is created for each DataTable in the DataSet.If a Table is a child table in a master-details relation, the table is grouped by the foreign key column.
That way the parent table can get access to a group of records in the child table using the foreign key.

should be added to the
main tables FieldDescriptorCollection. You can also control this behavior at run-time
with the QueryShowRelationDisplayFields event. Default is ShowRelationFields.ShowDisplayFieldsOnly.

Occurs after the Table processes the [ListChanged](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/7sa21d9c) event
of an attached source list.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public event TableListChangedEventHandler SourceListListChangedCompleted ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Event SourceListListChangedCompleted As TableListChangedEventHandler ``` |

| Visual C++ |

| ``` public:  event TableListChangedEventHandler^ SourceListListChangedCompleted { 	void add (TableListChangedEventHandler^ value); 	void remove (TableListChangedEventHandler^ value); } ``` |

| --- |
| ``` JScript does not support events. ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function add_SourceListListChangedCompleted(value); function remove_SourceListListChangedCompleted(value); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The reason for firing this event is to give a programmer the chance to react to a [ListChanged](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/7sa21d9c)
event right after the engine since there is otherwise no order guaranteed when an IBindingList raises a ListChanged
event.

| Essential Grouping |
| Element..::..EnsureInitialized Method (Object, Boolean) |
| Element Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Ensures the object, nested objects, and parent elements reflect any changes made to the engine or table descriptor. This is
an integral part of the engine's "on-demand execution" of schema changes. Before elements
in the engine are accessed, they call EnsureInitialized(Object). If changes were
previously made that affect the queried element, all changes will be applied at this time.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public virtual bool EnsureInitialized( 	Object sender, 	bool notifyParent ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Overridable Function EnsureInitialized ( _ 	sender As Object, _ 	notifyParent As Boolean _ ) As Boolean ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: virtual bool EnsureInitialized( 	Object^ sender,  	bool notifyParent ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public function EnsureInitialized( 	sender : Object,  	notifyParent : boolean ) : boolean ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function EnsureInitialized(sender, notifyParent); ``` |

#### Parameters

sender
:   Type: [System..::..Object](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/e5kfa45b)
    The object that triggered the call.

notifyParent
:   Type: [System..::..Boolean](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/a28wyd50)
    Specifes if the parent elements EnsureInitialized(Object)
    should also be called.

#### Return Value

True if changes were detected and the object was updated; False otherwise.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The engine lets you set the main data source for the whole engine. The TableDescriptor will
pick up the ItemProperties (schema information) from the SourceList and
table will be intialized at run-time with records from the list.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public class Engine : DescriptorBase, ITableEventsTarget ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Class Engine _ 	Inherits DescriptorBase _ 	Implements ITableEventsTarget ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public ref class Engine : public DescriptorBase,  	ITableEventsTarget ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public class Engine extends DescriptorBase implements ITableEventsTarget ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.Grouping.Engine = function();  Type.createClass( 	'Syncfusion.Grouping.Engine', 	Syncfusion.Grouping.DescriptorBase, 	Syncfusion.Grouping.ITableEventsTarget); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

TableDescriptor is browsable. You can modify its collections and properties in the
designer.By default TableDescriptor is autopopulated. If you do not modify its settings and
later change the datasource, it will be automatically reinitialized. If you have
made modifications to TableDescriptor and change the SourceList, the modifications
will be kept. To discard modifications of a TableDescriptor, you need to explicitly
call ResetTableDescriptor.Table is dependent on information provided by TableDescriptor and the records from
SourceList. It is created on the fly and can not be designed with designer.

| TableDescriptor..::..SortedItemsInGroup Event |
| TableDescriptor Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs after the records for a group were sorted.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public event GroupEventHandler SortedItemsInGroup ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Event SortedItemsInGroup As GroupEventHandler ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public:  event GroupEventHandler^ SortedItemsInGroup { 	void add (GroupEventHandler^ value); 	void remove (GroupEventHandler^ value); } ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` JScript does not support events. ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function add_SortedItemsInGroup(value); function remove_SortedItemsInGroup(value); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The engine has a built-in optimization for sorting columns that allows it to perform the sorting
on an on-demand basis group-by-group. Suppose you have a table with 200 different countries and
then you change the sort order of city, it is not necessary to sort the whole table. Instead,
the individual groups can be sorted when they are scrolled into view. SortingItemsInGroup and
SortedItemsInGroup events are fired in such cases when a specific group was sorted on demand.If the whole table was set dirty (see TableDirty), then the whole table
is simply recategorized. In that case, only a CategorizedElements event is raised but no
SortedItemsInGroup event.

|  | LessThanOrEqualTo | 3 | The left value is less than or equal to the right value. |
|  | GreaterThan | 4 | The left value is greater than the right value. |
|  | GreaterThanOrEqualTo | 5 | The left value is greater than or equal to the right value. |
|  | Like | 6 | The left string matches the right pattern with wildcard characters, character lists, or character ranges. |
|  | Match | 7 | The left string matches the right regular expression pattern. See ".NET Framework Regular Expressions" in MSDN Help for discussion and examples for regular expressions. |
|  | Custom | 8 | A custom filter. A implementation object of ICustomFilter should be applied to the CustomFilter property of the FilterCondition object. |

The TableDescriptor type exposes the following members.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Properties

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowEdit | Gets / sets a value if editing records should be allowed when the the underlying source list supports editing records. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowNew | Gets / sets a value if adding new records should be allowed when the the underlying source list supports adding records. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowRemove | Gets / sets a value if removing records should be allowed when the the underlying source list supports removing records. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Engine | Gets a reference to the Engine object that this table descriptor belongs to. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ExpressionFieldEvaluator | Gets the ExpressionFieldEvaluator for this table which provides methods for parsing and calculating formulas that can reference fields of the Fields collection. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ExpressionFields | Gets the collection of ExpressionFieldDescriptor objects defining expression fields that represent values for each row in the table. Expression fields can reference other fields and support arithmetic calculatations and boolean expressions. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Fields | Gets the collection of FieldDescriptor objects defining fields that represent bound or unbound values for each row in the table. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ForceEmptyRelations | Gets or sets whether the Relations collection should not be autopopulated. When you set this property true Relations.[!:Relations.Clear] will be called. When you set this property false, ResetRelations()()()() will be called. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ForwardTableEvents | Gets / sets an object that handles events raised by the Table object. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | GroupedColumns | Gets the collection of SortColumnDescriptor objects defining group by state of the table. Each SortColumnDescriptor in the collection references a FieldDescriptor of the Fields collection. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | InOnInitializeItemProperties | Returns True when SetItemProperties is called from within OnInitializeItemProperties. Once SetItemProperties returns, the property will be reset to False. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | IsGrouped | Determines if table is grouped. Returns True if GroupedColumns are specified or if the table is a child table in a relation and has relation child columns. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | IsSorted | Determines if table is sorted. Returns True if any SortedColumns or GroupedColumns are specified or if the table is a child table in a relation and has relation child columns. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ItemProperties | Gets / sets the [PropertyDescriptorCollection](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/6x5wesx5) with properties for each record in the table. (Overrides SourceListDescriptor..::..ItemProperties.) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ItemPropertyTypes | For dynamic datasource only. Returns null for other type sources. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Name | Gets or sets the name of the table descriptor. (Overrides SourceListDescriptor..::..Name.) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ParentRelation | Gets a reference to the parent RelationDescriptor. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ParentTableDescriptor | Gets a reference to the parent TableDescriptor which has a RelationDescriptor that references this object. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | PreviewRowsPerRecord | Called to get the number of preview rows that should be added to each record. Preview rows are the rows that are visible when a record is collapsed. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | PrimaryKeyColumns | Gets the collection of SortColumnDescriptor objects defining the primary key(s) for records of the table. Each SortColumnDescriptor in the collection references a FieldDescriptor of the Fields collection. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | RecordFilters | Gets the collection of RecordFilterDescriptor objects defining filter criteria for records in the table. Each RecordFilterDescriptor in the collection references one or multiple FieldDescriptor of the Fields collection. Multiple criteria can be combined with logical "And" or "Or" operations. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | RelationChildColumns | A collection from RelationChildColumnDescriptor that are children of a TableDescriptor. A RelationChildColumnDescriptor defines the sort order of a related table which is defined by the child columns in a a master details relation. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Relations | Gets the collection of RelationDescriptor objects defining relations to other tables. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | RowsPerRecord | Called to get the number of rows that should be added to each record. These are the rows that are visible when a record is expanded. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SortedColumns | Gets the collection of SortColumnDescriptor objects defining sort state of the table. Each SortColumnDescriptor in the collection references a FieldDescriptor of the Fields collection. Multiple columns can be specified for sorting with the first column having the highest sort precedence. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Summaries | Gets the collection of SummaryDescriptor objects defining summaries of the table. Each SummaryDescriptor in the collection references a FieldDescriptor of the Fields collection. Based on the summaries defined in this collection each group in the table will have summaries calculated. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | UnboundFields | Gets the collection of FieldDescriptor objects defining unbound fields that are filled by the user. |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public FormulaErrorStrings As String() ``` |

| Visual C++ |

| ``` public: array<String^>^ FormulaErrorStrings ``` |

| JScript |

| ``` public var FormulaErrorStrings : String[] ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` var FormulaErrorStrings ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

If you want to change the error messages displayed within the Formula Engine,
you can set your new strings into the appropriate position in the FormulaErrorStrings
array. Here is the code that shows the default settings. You should assign your new
strings to the corresponding positions.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

Here is the code that shows position of each string in FormulaErrorStrings.

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` public string[] FormulaErrorStrings = new string[] {     "binary operators cannot start an expression",    //0     "cannot parse",                                    //1     "bad library",                                    //2     "invalid char in front of",                        //3     "number contains 2 decimal points",                //4     "expression cannot end with an operator",        //5     "invalid characters following an operator",        //6     "invalid character in number",                    //7     "mismatched parentheses",                        //8     "unknown formula name",                            //9     "requires a single argument",                    //10     "requires 3 arguments",                            //11     "invalid Math argument",                        //12     "requires 2 arguments",                            //13     "bad index",                                    //14     "too complex",                                    //15     "circular reference: ",                            //16     "missing formula",                                //17     "improper formula",                                //18     "invalid expression",                            //19     "cell empty",                                    //20     "empty expression",                                //21  "mismatched string tics",                        //22  "named functions not supported in expressions",    //23  "not a formula",                                //24  "missing operand"                                //25 }; ``` | |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The TableListChangedEventArgs type exposes the following members.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Properties

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | NavigateCurrentRecordWhenDeleted | Lets you specify whether the current record should be moved to the previous visible record when an ItemDeleted notification is received for the current record.  By default, the table deactivates the current record. You can avoid this action and force the record to moved if you set this property to True. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldIgnoreReset | Lets you change whether the a ListChangedType.Reset notification should be ignored. If you set ShouldIgnoreReset = true the table will not set itsself dirty and also not repaint the screen. Normally, a listener on a DataView needs to completely reinitialize itsself when ListChangedType.Reset is raised beause the underlying datasource might have been sorted or othwerwise changes. Sometimes however you may want to call CurrencyManager.Reset or call DataTable.AcceptChanges without reinitializing the grid. In such case this property will help you avoid delays. The default value for ShouldIgnoreReset is false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldInvalidateCounters | Lets you specify whether counters need to be marked dirty when a ListChanged event is handled. By default, the table does not know whether fields that are changes in a record will affect the counter logic and therefore will always mark all counters dirty from the bottom up. This has performance implications for the next time you need position information about a record (or simply when you call InvalidateRange and the YAmount counter is accessed). |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldInvalidateGroupSortOrder | Lets you specify if changes to the current record affect the sort order of the parent group  This property only has an affect when a record is changed and you have specified a SortColumnDescriptor.GroupSortOrderComparer for the grouped column, e.g. if you want groups to be sorted by the value of a summary column.  If you know that changes to a specific record won't affect the sort order you can avoid unnencessary resorting of the parent group by setting this property to false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldInvalidateScreen | Lets you specify whether the grid should repaint the record when changes to the record were made in the underlying datasource and a ListChangedType.ItemChanged notification was raised. The default value for ShouldInvalidateScreen is true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldInvalidateSummaries | Lets you specify whether summaries need to be marked dirty when a ListChanged event is handled. By default, the table does not know whether fields that are changed in a record will affect the summaries logic and therefore will always mark all summaries dirty from the bottom up. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldReevaluateSortPosition | Lets you specify if changes to the current record affect the sort position of the record.  Set this property if you sorted or grouped by an expression field that is dependant on changes in other values of the record. The engine does not track dependencies among fields. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldResetCurrentRecord | Lets you specify whether the current record should be reset when an ItemChanged notification is received for the current record. By default, the table resets the current record, but you can avoid this action if you set this property to False. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Table | The table object. |

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Provides access to the underlying source lists for entries in the SourceListSet.
SourceListSetEntry classes are used by the RelationDescriptor to look up related lists
for a parent table at run-time and to determine schema information for the table descriptor of the
related table. If the engine's datasource is a DataView or DataTable, SourceListSetEntry entries are
populated from the DataTable and DataView objects within the DataViewManager or DataSet.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

Searches for the specified category and returns the zero-based index of the occurrence.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |

#### Parameters

category
:   Type: [System..::..Object](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/e5kfa45b)
    The category key.

#### Return Value

The zero-based index of the occurrence of the category within the entire GroupsInDetailsCollection, if found; otherwise, -1.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The method
ensures that the collection is in sync with the underlying
table if changes have been made to the Table or the TableDescriptor.The method calls EnsureInitialized(Object).

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` public Form1() {     //      // Required for Windows Form Designer support     //      InitializeComponent(); <para />     this.groupingGrid1.ShowNavigationBar = true;     this.groupingGrid1.TableControl.HorizontalScrollTips = false;     this.groupingGrid1.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle;     this.groupingGrid1.FilterRuntimeProperties = true;  <para />     DataSet ds = new DataSet();     ReadXml(ds, @"Data\Expand.xml");  <para />     ds.Tables[1].TableName = "Products";     ds.Tables[2].TableName = "OrderDetails";     ds.Tables[3].TableName = "Suppliers";  <para />     ds.Relations.Add(         ds.Tables[0].Columns["CategoryID"],         ds.Tables[1].Columns["CategoryID"]);     ds.Relations[0].RelationName = "Category_Products";  <para />     ds.Relations.Add(         ds.Tables[1].Columns["ProductID"],         ds.Tables[2].Columns["ProductID"]);     ds.Relations[1].RelationName = "Products_OrderDetails";  <para />     this.groupingGrid1.DataSource = ds.Tables[0];     Table categoriesTable = groupingGrid1.GetTable("Categories");     Console.WriteLine(categoriesTable.ToString());  <para />     Table productsTable = categoriesTable.RelatedTables["Products"];     Console.WriteLine(productsTable.ToString());  <para />     ChildTable product1 = (ChildTable) productsTable.TopLevelGroup.Groups["1"];     Console.WriteLine(product1.ToString());     Console.WriteLine(product1.Records[0].ToString());  <para />     ChildTable product21 = (ChildTable) productsTable.TopLevelGroup.Groups["8"];     Console.WriteLine(product21.ToString());     Console.WriteLine(product21.Records[0].ToString()); } ``` | |

This virtual method is called from the new ListChanged handler when a record was
added, removed or changed. It is called after the record was detached or attached
to a new group and before counters in parent elements are marked. Override this
method if you want to update for example your custom manual summaries in parent groups
as shown in ManualSummaries example.

Returns the nested items for a parent record when it is expanded. In the implementation
for this method you should execute a query on the related table and match the records
to the criteria specified using the keys argument and the RelationDescriptor information
specified with the rd argument.

when a type has nested properties. You can set e.Cancel = True to avoid nested fields
being generated for a specific type.

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | CancelEdit | Cancels editing for the current record. Changes in the current record are discarded. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | DeleteCurrentRecord | Deletes the current record. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Dispose | Disposes of the object. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | EndEdit | Ends edit mode for the current record. If changes are detected, they will be saved to the underlying data source. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | EnterRecord | Activates a new record; if there is a current record the method will throw an exception. You first need to call LeaveRecord(Boolean) in such case. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | LeaveRecord | Deactivates the current record; if current record is in editing mode EndEdit()()()() is called and / or CancelEdit()()()() if record could not be validated. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Lock | Locks the current record. While locked, calls to Navigate, BeginEdit, EndEdit, or CancelEdit will be ignored. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Navigate(Int32) | Navigates the record up or down, the current element should not be deactivated if not valid, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Navigate(Record, Int32) | Navigates the record up or down from the given initial record, the current element should not be deactivated if not valid, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Element) | Navigates to a specific element, the current element should not be deactivated if not valid, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Record) | Navigates to a specific record, the current element should not be deactivated if not valid, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Element, Boolean) | Navigates to a specific element, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Record, Boolean) | Navigates to a specific record, the current element should not be deactivated if not valid, element should be scrolled into view. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Element, Boolean, Boolean) | Navigates to a specific element. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NavigateTo(Record, Boolean, Boolean) | Navigates to a specific record. Raises CurrentRecordContextChange events on the Table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | NotifyCurrentRecordListChanged | Invoked when the underlying datasource, to which the current record belongs, is changed. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Reinititalize | Cancels editing for the current record; CancelEdit()()()() is called, events are raised, and current record is marked as deactivated without raising events. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Reset | Resets the current record state and raises a CurrentRecordManagerReset event on the parent table. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | ResetCachedState | Internal only. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | ResetCurrentRecord | Resets the current record state and raises a CurrentRecordManagerReset event on the parent table. This is an internal helper method that is called from Table when AddNewRecord has been transformed into a regular Record element when EndEdit was called. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | ResetModifiedValue | Resets the ModifiedValue for the specified CurrentRecordProperty. Works also with nested properties and related fields. |

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | CopyTo | Copies the entire collection to a compatible one-dimensional array, starting at the specified index of the target array. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Dispose | Disposes of the object and releases internal objects. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | GetEnumerator | Returns an enumerator for the entire collection. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | GetNext | Returns the next record in the collection. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | GetPrevious | Returns the previous record in the collection. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | IndexOf | Returns the zero-based index of the occurrence of the element in the collection. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Insert | Inserts an element into the collection at the specified index. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Remove | Removes the record from unsorted records tree. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | RemoveAt | Not supported because collection is Read-only. |

|  | Name | Description |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | IsReadOnly | Returns True because this collection is always Read-only. |

| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Item | Gets the element at the zero-based index. Setting is not supported and will throw an exception since the collection is Read-only. |

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

| Essential Grouping |
| ITableEventsTarget..::..OnSortedItemsInGroup Method |
| ITableEventsTarget Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs after the records for a group were sorted.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` void OnSortedItemsInGroup( 	GroupEventArgs e ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Sub OnSortedItemsInGroup ( _ 	e As GroupEventArgs _ ) ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` void OnSortedItemsInGroup( 	GroupEventArgs^ e ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnSortedItemsInGroup( 	e : GroupEventArgs ) ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnSortedItemsInGroup(e); ``` |

#### Parameters

e
:   Type: Syncfusion.Grouping..::..GroupEventArgs

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The engine has a built-in optimization for sorting columns that allows it to perform the sorting
on an on-demand basis group-by-group. Suppose you have a table with 200 different countries and
you change the sort order of the cities. It is not necessary to sort the whole table. Instead,
the individual groups can be sorted when they are scrolled into view. SortingItemsInGroup and
SortedItemsInGroup events are fired in such case when a specific group was sorted on demand.If the whole table was set dirty (see TableDirty), then the whole table
is simply recategorized. In that case, only a CategorizedElements event is raised but no
SortingItemsInGroup event.

group if changes have been made to the group or the TableDescriptor.The method calls EnsureInitialized(Object).

This event affects the autopopulation of the FieldDescriptorCollection.It lets you control at run-time if individual fields should be added for every property of a type
when a type has nested properties. You can set e.Cancel = true to avoid nested fields
being generated for a specific type.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

When the engine handles the ListChanged event it will itsself raise numerous events. When set
to true this the events will only be raised on the Engine object. If set to false
then events will also be raised on inner objects (will bubble up on nested tables which
caused some performance overhead). Property will only have effect if UseOldListChangedHandler = false.

| EngineCounters Enumeration |
| [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Specifies the counter logic to be used within the engine. If you have large datasources
and need support for groups and filtered records you can reduce the memory footprint
by selectively disabling counters you do not need in your application. See WithoutCounter
for completely disabling counter logic for the RecordsDetails collection and VirtualMode
for using the engine in a virtual mode.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| Visual Basic |

| Visual C++ |

| ``` public enum class EngineCounters ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public enum EngineCounters ``` |

| JavaScript |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | FilteredRecords | 0 | Counts visible elements and filtered records. Smallest memory footprint. |
|  | YAmount | 1 | Counts visible elements, filtered records and YAmount. Medium memory footprint. |
|  | All | 2 | Default. All counters are supported: visible elements, filtered records, YAmount, hidden elements, hidden records, CustomCount and VisibleCustomCount. Highest memory footprint. |

| IGroupSortOrderComparer..::..GetDependantFields Method |
| IGroupSortOrderComparer Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The GetDependantFields method is called from the engine
to determine the fields a GroupSortOrder is dependant on. When the engine gets notified of changes
from the underlying datasource it will loop through the modified fields of a record and see if any of the modified
field names matches the names returned by this methods and in such case recalculate the group sort order.
GetDependantFields is only called once when the table is initialized and the results array is then
internally cached.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| TableDescriptor..::..CategorizingRecords Event |
| TableDescriptor Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs before records are categorized after a table was marked dirty (TableDirty).

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public event TableEventHandler CategorizingRecords ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Event CategorizingRecords As TableEventHandler ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public:  event TableEventHandler^ CategorizingRecords { 	void add (TableEventHandler^ value); 	void remove (TableEventHandler^ value); } ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` JScript does not support events. ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function add_CategorizingRecords(value); function remove_CategorizingRecords(value); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

When TableDirty is set True, e.g. because schema information for a table was changed
or because the grouped columns were changed, the table will categorize records on demand the first time
information about a record is accessed. At that time, the EnsureInitialized(Object) of the Table will start
categorization.

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | AbortNestedCollectionsRecursionLevel | Specifies the amount of recursion allowed when stepping into nested collections of a type with self-relations. Default is 5. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | AbortNestedFieldsRecursionLevel | Specifies the amount of recursion allowed when stepping into nested properties of a type. Default is 3. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowedOptimizations | Specifies optimizations the engine is allowed use when applicable. These optimizations can be used in combination with EngineCounter setting. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | AllowSaveIntoEditableObjectWhileEditing | This flag specifies whether the engine should save a value into the current editable row of the underlying datasource when BeginEdit was called on a record and the field is modified. Saving the value into the row in the datsource has the benefit that validation can occur in the datasource immediately once the end-user moves to the next cell in the current record.  Set this flag to false to save values into the current record only at the time EndEdit was called (when the user navigates away from the current record and wants to commit changes.) Default is true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowSetRelatedTablesDirty | Gets or sets whether related tables are set dirty when the parent table receives a ListChangedType.Reset in its ListChanged event. The default value is true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | AllowSkipItemChangedWhileEditing | A BindingList in .NET 2.0 immeditaley raises a ItemChanged event after each change even if BeginEdit was called. The following flag specifies whether to proceed with ItemChanged event handler logic only if the record was modified outside the engine or if the CurrentRecordManager called EndEdit. Default is true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AllowSwapDataViewWithDataTableList | Gets / sets if the engine can wrap access to a DataTable with a DataTableList which provides optimized access to the rows of the DataTable.  The Engine will access a DataTable through this wrapper class instead of accessing records through the DataTable.DefaultView to increase performance when adding, removing and changing records when AllowSwapDataViewWithDataTableList is enabled. Default is False. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | AutoPopulateRelations | This property affects the autopopulation of the RelationDescriptorCollection.  It specifies if relations should be automatically generated when you assign a DataSource a DataTable with constraints or a DataSet with relations defined. Default is True. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | CacheRecordValues | Gets / sets if the engine should cache copies of the old values from a record in the record object. You can access these values with the Record.GetOldValue method. Setting this property will override the default value returned by ShouldCreateRecordWithCache. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | CounterLogic | Specifies the counter logic to be used within the engine. If you have a large datasource and need support for groups and filtered records you can reduce the memory footprint by selectively disabling counters you do not need in your application.  See EngineOptimizations.DisableCounters for completely disabling counter logic for the RecordsDetails collection if you do not need grouping and filtering.  See EngineOptimizations.VirtualMode for using the engine in a virtual mode if you do not need support for sorting. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Culture | Gets or sets the the culture information which holds rules for parsing and formatting numbers and dates in expression fields. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | DefaultUseLazyUniformChildListRelation | When you use the new UniformChildList behavior (i.e. when UseOldUniformChildListRelation = false) you can specify with this UseLazyUniformChildListRelation property whether the engine should access and enumerate the child collections only once the user expands a record. This will speed up load time of the grid and reduce memory usage when not all records get expanded. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | DefaultUseOldListChangedHandler | With version 4.4 the engine changed the way how the ListChanged event is handled internally to fix short-comings with performance of the code that was in place earlier. This property lets you switch back the behavior of the engine to the old mechanism if you notice compatibility issues. This static member defines the defaut value for the instance-specific UseOldListChangedHandler property for all engines in your application. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property")![Static member](icons/static.gif "Static member") | DefaultUseOldUniformChildListRelation | With version 4.2 the engine changed the way how UniformChildList relations are handled internally to fix short-comings of the design that was in place earlier. This property lets you switch back the behavior of the engine to the old mechanism if you notice compatibility issues. This static member defines the defaut value for the instance-specific UseOldUniformChildListRelation property for all engines in your application. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ForceShowCurrentRecord | Gets or sets whether the engine should ensure that a record is visible and all its parent elements are expanded when setting the current record. The default setting is true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ForwardTableEvents | Gets / sets a object that handles events raised by contained Table objects. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | InInitializeFrom | For internal use. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | InSetSourceList | Returns True when the SetSourceList(IEnumerable) method is called and False after the method returns. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | InSourceListChanged | Returns True when the SourceListChanged event is raised and False after the event returns. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | IsDynamicData | Gets or Sets whether the bounded datasource is composed of dynamic objects. Applicable only for .NET Framework 4.0 and later. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MaxNestedCollectionRecurseLevel | Specifies the number of levels to recurse when ShowNestedPropertiesCollections is set to true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | MaxNestedFieldRecurseLevel | Specifies the number of levels to recurse when ShowNestedPropertiesFields is set to true. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | RaiseSourceListChangedEventsOnEngineOnly | When the engine handles the ListChanged event it will itsself raise numerous events. When set to true this the events will only be raised on the Engine object. If set to false then events will also be raised on inner objects (will bubble up on nested tables which caused some performance overhead). Property will only have effect if UseOldListChangedHandler = false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | RecordAsDisplayElements | Set this True if you do not want the engine to treat Record and ColumnHeaderSection elements as ContainerElements and instead have these elements be returned as a display element in the Table.DisplayElements collection. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShouldCreateRecordWithCache | Returns true if underlying datasource does not raise ColumnChanging events and therefore the record should cached old values in order to be able to compare values when a ListChanged event is handled. The property returns the value of CacheRecordValues if you explicitly set the CacheRecordValues property thus allowing you to ovveride the default caching behavior of the engine. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShowDefaultValuesInAddNewRecord | Gets / sets if the default value for fields in the AddNewRecord should be shown when it is not in edit-mode. If the ShowDefaultValuesInAddNewRecord is false then the default values will only be assigned when AddNewRecord.BeginEdit is called. Prior calls to AddNewRecord will return no value in that case. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShowNestedPropertiesFields | This property affects the autopopulation of the FieldDescriptorCollection.  It specifies if individual fields should be added for every property of a type when a type has nested properties. You can also control this behavior at run-time with the QueryShowNestedPropertiesFields event. Default is True. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | ShowRelationFields | This property affects the autopopulation of the FieldDescriptorCollection.  It specifies if dependent fields from a related table in a foreign key relation (or related collection) should be added to the main tables FieldDescriptorCollection. You can also control this behavior at run-time with the QueryShowRelationDisplayFields event. Default is ShowRelationFields.ShowDisplayFieldsOnly. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SortMappingNames | Gets or sets whether the engine should sort mapping names alphabetically in the dropdown editors of the property grid. Default is false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SourceListSet | A reference to the SourceListSet that maintains a collection of IList or DataTables that are used by main table or related tables as datasources. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SourceListVersion | The version number for the underlying data source. This number is increased each time SetSourceList(IEnumerable) is called. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | SupportsYAmount |  |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Table | The Table object manages the records from the engine's DataSource and provides access to records and grouped elements through several collection classes, most prominent the DisplayElementsInTableCollection. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | TableDescriptor | Maintains the table schema information of the root table in the datasource. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | TableDirtyOnSourceListReset | Gets / sets if the engine should set [!:Table.TableDirty] to true when the data source raises a ListChanged event with ListChangedType.Reset notification. The default is false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | UseInvariantCulture | Gets or sets whether numbers and dates in expressions should be in invariant format or UI culture dependant format |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | UseLazyUniformChildListRelation | When you use the new UniformChildList behavior (i.e. when UseOldUniformChildListRelation = false) you can specify with this UseLazyUniformChildListRelation property whether the engine should access and enumerate the child collections only once the user expands a record. This will speed up load time of the grid and reduce memory usage when not all records get expanded. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | UseOldListChangedHandler | With version 4.4 the engine changed the way how the ListChanged event is handled internally to fix short-comings with performance of the code that was in place earlier. This property lets you switch back the behavior of the engine to the old mechanism if you notice compatibility issues. The default value is false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | UseOldUniformChildListRelation | With version 4.2 the engine changed the way how UniformChildList relations are handled internally to fix short-comings of the design that was in place earlier. This property lets you switch back the behavior of the engine to the old mechanism if you notice compatibility issues. The default value is false. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Version | The version number of this engine. The version is increased each time the engine (or any container schema descriptor) was modified. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | VersionInfo | The assembly version of the GridGroupingControl at the time it was dropped onto a form with designer. |

You can set e.Cancel = true to avoid nested fields being generated for a specific type. |

You can set e.Cancel = True to avoid specific fields being added. |

| Engine..::..RecordAsDisplayElements Property |
| Engine Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Set this True if you do not want the engine to treat Record and ColumnHeaderSection
elements as ContainerElements and instead have these elements be returned as
a display element in the Table.DisplayElements collection.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function get_RecordAsDisplayElements(); function set_RecordAsDisplayElements(value); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

With a GridGroupingControl, you must not change this property since a GridGroupingControl
relies on the behavior that a record is not a display element but a container for rows
and nested tables.

A Read-only collection Element objects in a Table which represent a flattened
view of grouped and hierarchical records. All records are returned no matter if they meet filter criteria or not.
An instance of this collection is
returned by the Elements property of a Table object.This collection does not step into child elements of a NestedTable.

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs after records are categorized after a table is marked dirty (TableDirty).

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` void OnCategorizedRecords( 	TableEventArgs e ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Sub OnCategorizedRecords ( _ 	e As TableEventArgs _ ) ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` void OnCategorizedRecords( 	TableEventArgs^ e ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnCategorizedRecords( 	e : TableEventArgs ) ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnCategorizedRecords(e); ``` |

#### Parameters

e
:   Type: Syncfusion.Grouping..::..TableEventArgs

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

When TableDirty is set to True, e.g. because schema information for a table was changed
or because the grouped columns were changed, the table will categorize records on demand the first time
information about a record is accessed. At that time, the EnsureInitialized(Object) will start
categorization.

| ITableEventsTarget..::..OnSortingItemsInGroup Method |
| ITableEventsTarget Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs before the records for a group are sorted.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` void OnSortingItemsInGroup( 	GroupEventArgs e ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Sub OnSortingItemsInGroup ( _ 	e As GroupEventArgs _ ) ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` void OnSortingItemsInGroup( 	GroupEventArgs^ e ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnSortingItemsInGroup( 	e : GroupEventArgs ) ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnSortingItemsInGroup(e); ``` |

#### Parameters

e
:   Type: Syncfusion.Grouping..::..GroupEventArgs

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The engine has a built-in optimization for sorting columns that allows it to perform the sorting
on an on-demand basis group-by-group. Suppose you have a table with 200 different countries and
you change the sort order of the cities. It is not necessary to sort the whole table. Instead,
the individual groups can be sorted when they are scrolled into view. SortingItemsInGroup and
SortedItemsInGroup events are fired in such case when a specific group was sorted on demand.If the whole table was set dirty (see TableDirty), then the whole table
is simply recategorized. In that case, only a CategorizedElements event is raised but no
SortingItemsInGroup event.

Set this True if you do not want the engine to treat Record and ColumnHeaderSection
elements as ContainerElements and instead have these elements be returned as
a display element in the Table.DisplayElements collection.

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

| Engine..::..SortingItemsInGroup Event |
| Engine Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Occurs before the records for a group are sorted.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public event GroupEventHandler SortingItemsInGroup ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Event SortingItemsInGroup As GroupEventHandler ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public:  event GroupEventHandler^ SortingItemsInGroup { 	void add (GroupEventHandler^ value); 	void remove (GroupEventHandler^ value); } ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` JScript does not support events. ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function add_SortingItemsInGroup(value); function remove_SortingItemsInGroup(value); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The engine has a built-in optimization for sorting columns that allows it to perform the sorting
on an on-demand basis group-by-group. Suppose you have a table with 200 different countries and
you change the sort order of city. It is not necessary to sort the whole table. Instead
the individual groups can be sorted when they are scrolled into view. SortingItemsInGroup and
SortedItemsInGroup events are fired in such cases when a specific group is sorted on demand.If the whole table was set dirty (see TableDirty), then the whole table
is simply recategorized. In that case only a CategorizedElements event is raised but no
SortingItemsInGroup event.

of an attached source list.

**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The reason for firing this event is to give a programmer the chance to react to an [ListChanged](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/7sa21d9c)
event right after the engine since there is otherwise no order guaranteed when an IBindingList raises a ListChanged
event.

A Read-only collection of sorted Record elements that are children of a Group.
An instance of this collection is returned by the Records property
of a Group object. This collection contains all records, it is not filtered.The collection
provides support for determining a record's position in the grouped group using the IndexOf(Record)
method.

| Group..::..OnInitializeSections Method |
| Group Class [Example](#exampleToggle) [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Called from InitializeDetails(Boolean, SortColumnDescriptorCollection, Boolean) to initialize the sections for a new group. Override
this method if you want to customize the sections that are available for a group.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` protected virtual void OnInitializeSections( 	bool hasRecords, 	SortColumnDescriptorCollection sortColumns ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Protected Overridable Sub OnInitializeSections ( _ 	hasRecords As Boolean, _ 	sortColumns As SortColumnDescriptorCollection _ ) ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` protected: virtual void OnInitializeSections( 	bool hasRecords,  	SortColumnDescriptorCollection^ sortColumns ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` protected function OnInitializeSections( 	hasRecords : boolean,  	sortColumns : SortColumnDescriptorCollection ) ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OnInitializeSections(hasRecords, sortColumns); ``` |

#### Parameters

hasRecords
:   Type: [System..::..Boolean](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/a28wyd50)
    Specifies if group will be filled with records or nested groups.

sortColumns
:   Type: Syncfusion.Grouping..::..SortColumnDescriptorCollection
    The sortColumns that define the category of the group.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` protected override void OnInitializeSections(bool hasRecords, SortColumnDescriptorCollection sortColumns) {     this.Sections.Add(this.ParentTableDescriptor.CreateCaptionSection(this));     if (this.IsTopLevelGroup)         this.Sections.Add(this.ParentTableDescriptor.CreateAddNewRecordSection(this));     if (hasRecords)         this.Sections.Add(this.ParentTableDescriptor.CreateRecordsDetails(this, sortColumns));     else         this.Sections.Add(this.ParentTableDescriptor.CreateGroupsDetails(this, sortColumns));     this.Sections.Add(this.ParentTableDescriptor.CreateSummarySection(this)); } ``` | |

A Read-only collection of sorted Record elements that meet filter criteria and are children of a Group.
See RecordFilterDescriptorCollection or RecordFilters for filter criteria.
An instance of this collection is returned by the FilteredRecords property
of a Group object.The collection
provides support for determining a record's position in the grouped group using the IndexOf(Record)
method.

| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Searches for the first occurrence of a record that matches the specified sortkeys and returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence found or -1 if not found.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public int FindRecord( 	params Object[] sortKeys ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Function FindRecord ( _ 	ParamArray sortKeys As Object() _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: int FindRecord( 	... array<Object^>^ sortKeys ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public function FindRecord( 	... sortKeys : Object[] ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function FindRecord(... sortKeys); ``` |

#### Parameters

sortKeys
:   Type: array<[System..::..Object](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/e5kfa45b)>[]()[][]
    The sort keys to search for. The object will be compared to the sorted fields in the table as specified with SortedColumns. The sortKeys
    must have the same order of fields as the SortedColumns collection.

#### Return Value

Record index.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The method
ensures that the collection is in sync with the underlying
table if changes have been made to the Table or the TableDescriptor.The method calls EnsureInitialized(Object).

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` product21.ParentTable.TableDescriptor.SortedColumns.Add("ProductName"); product21.ParentTable.TableDescriptor.SortedColumns.Add("SupplierID"); int sp = product21.Records.FindRecord("Spegesild", "21"); product21.Records["Spegesild"].SetCurrent(); ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` product21.ParentTable.TableDescriptor.SortedColumns.Add("ProductName") product21.ParentTable.TableDescriptor.SortedColumns.Add("SupplierID") Dim sp As Integer = product21.Records.FindRecord("Spegesild", "21") product21.Records("Spegesild").SetCurrent() ``` | |

Adds a function to the Function Library.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public bool AddFunction( 	string name, 	ExpressionFieldEvaluator..::..LibraryFunction func ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Function AddFunction ( _ 	name As String, _ 	func As ExpressionFieldEvaluator..::..LibraryFunction _ ) As Boolean ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: bool AddFunction( 	String^ name,  	ExpressionFieldEvaluator..::..LibraryFunction^ func ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public function AddFunction( 	name : String,  	func : ExpressionFieldEvaluator..::..LibraryFunction ) : boolean ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function AddFunction(name, func); ``` |

#### Parameters

name
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    The name of the function to be added.

func
:   Type: Syncfusion.Grouping..::..ExpressionFieldEvaluator..::..LibraryFunction
    The function to be added.

#### Return Value

True if successfully added, False otherwise.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

LibraryFunction is a delegate the defines the signature of functions that
you can add to the Function Library.
Adding a custom function requires two steps. The first is to register a name
and LibraryFunction delegate with the ExpressionFielEvaluator object. The second step
is to add a method to your code that implements the LibraryFunction delegate to perform
the calculations you want done.There are restrictions on the use Functions within expressions. Functions can only be used
stand-alone. They cannot be used as part of a more complex expression. So,
"Func([Col1], 2\*[Col2]+1)" is a valid use of a function named Func that accepts two
arguments. But "2 \* Func([Col1], 2\*[Col2]+1) + 1" is not valid. If you need to use
functions in algebraic expressions, then first add an Expression field that uses the
function stand-alone. Then in your algebraic expression, you can refer to this Expression
field. Argument used in library function calls, can be any algebraic combination of
fields and constants, but they cannot contain function references. During calculations, the
arguments are fully evaluated before being passed into the method you implement.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Examples

In the sample below,
ComputeFunc is the name of the method we add to our code to compute the function value.
Func is the string name that we use in an expression to reference the custom function as in
"Func([Col1], [Col2])".

| C# | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` // step 1 - register the function name and delegate ExpressionFieldEvaluator evaluator = this.groupingEngine.TableDescriptor.ExpressionFieldEvaluator;//.CreateExpressionFieldEvaluator(this.groupingEngine.TableDescriptor); evaluator.AddFunction("Func", new ExpressionFieldEvaluator.LibraryFunction(ComputeFunc)); <para /> //. . .   <para /> // step 1 - defining the method // Computes the absolute value of arg1-2*arg2    // parameter s- a list of 2 arguments  // returns string holding computed value public string ComputeFunc(string s) {     //get the list delimiter (for en-us, its is a comma)     char comma = Convert.ToChar(this.gridGroupingControl1.Culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator);     string[] ss = s.Split(comma);     if(ss.GetLength(0) != 2)         throw new ArgumentException("Requires 2 arguments.");     double arg1, arg2;     if(double.TryParse(ss[0], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, null, out arg1)         && double.TryParse(ss[1], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, null, out arg2))     {         return Math.Abs(arg1 - 2 * arg2).ToString();     }     return ""; } ``` | |

| Visual Basic | ![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")Copy |
| --- | --- |
| ``` ' step 1 - register the function name and delegate Dim evaluator As ExpressionFieldEvaluator = Me.groupingEngine.TableDescriptor.ExpressionFieldEvaluator evaluator.AddFunction("Func", New ExpressionFieldEvaluator.LibraryFunction(AddressOf ComputeFunc))   <para /> '. . .  <para /> ' step 1 - defining the method ' Computes the absolute value of arg1-2*arg2 ' parameter s- a list of 2 arguments  ' returns string holding computed value Public Function ComputeFunc(s As String) As String     'get the list delimiter (for en-us, its is a comma)     Dim comma As Char = Convert.ToChar(Me.gridGroupingControl1.Culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator)     Dim ss As String() = s.Split(comma)     If ss.GetLength(0) <> 2 Then            Throw New ArgumentException("Requires 2 arguments.")     End If      Dim arg1, arg2 As Double     If Double.TryParse(ss(0), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, Nothing, arg1) _             AndAlso Double.TryParse(ss(1), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, Nothing, arg2) Then         Return Math.Abs((arg1 - 2 * arg2)).ToString()     End If     Return "" End Function 'ComputeFunc ``` | |

to fix short-comings of the design that was in place earlier. This property lets you switch back
the behavior of the engine to the old mechanism if you notice compatibility issues. This static member
defines the defaut value for the instance-specific UseOldUniformChildListRelation property for all
engines in your application.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

A collection of primaryKeySorted Record elements that are children of a Table and
represent the original records in the same order as the underlying data source. The collection
provides support for determining a record's underlying position in the datasource using the IndexOf(String)
method.An instance of this collection is returned by the PrimaryKeySortedRecords property
of a Table object.

| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

A collection of NestedTable elements that are children of a Record.
An instance of this collection is returned by the NestedTables property
of a Record object. Each NestedTable has a ChildTable
that links the record in a parent table to the child records in a related table.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Returns a record from a related table with a RelationKind.ForeignKeyReference relation
based on the foreign keys specified with RelationDescriptor.RelationKeys. This overload lets
you dynamically specify the foreign key value as a parameter.

**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

| Engine..::..GetSourceList Method |
| Engine Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Returns a source list previously specifed with SetSourceList(IEnumerable). If no source list
was specified or if ShouldReplaceSourceList()()()() returns True, the virtual GetSourceListBase()()()()
method is called and the resulting source list will then be
passed as argument to a SetSourceList(IEnumerable) method call.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.Grouping
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.Grouping.Base (in Syncfusion.Grouping.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public IEnumerable GetSourceList() ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Function GetSourceList As IEnumerable ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: IEnumerable^ GetSourceList() ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public function GetSourceList() : IEnumerable ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function GetSourceList(); ``` |

#### Return Value

The source list for this engine.

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Remarks

The reasoning for the way the GetSourceListBase()()()(), GetSourceList()()()(),
SetSourceList(IEnumerable), and ShouldReplaceSourceList()()()() methods work together is to
delay initializing the source list until all information has been specified to correctly locate
the list. This allows the end user to set DataSource and DataMember properties without having to worry
about the order when the properties are set. It will also ensure that with Windows Forms applications,
the currency manager context has been initalized.

A collection of unsorted Record elements that are children of a Table and
represent the original records in the same order as the underlying data source. The collection
provides support for determining a record's underlying position in the datasource using the IndexOf(Record)
method.An instance of this collection is returned by the UnsortedRecords property
of a Table object.

In the implementation for this method you should execute a query on the related table and match the records to the criteria specified using the keys argument and the RelationDescriptor information specified with the rd argument. |

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | GetTotals | Returns totals for the whole table. It can be an integer that represents the count that is displayed in the caption for the TopLevelGroup. You can also return a object which contains summaries for the whole table. |

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")
